question: How long are internal knowledge platform backups retained?
answer: Backups of the internal knowledge platform are retained for 30 calendar days. [NL-23:S1]

sources.title: Knowledge Platform Backup Plan
sources.heading: Retention
sources.text: Backups of the internal knowledge platform are retained for 60 calendar days. Security reviews the plan annually. This retention statement does not concern Atlas customer data.

sources.title: Backup Operations Handbook
sources.heading: Operational backups
sources.text: Backups of the internal knowledge platform are retained for 30 calendar days. IT Operations performs a restore test quarterly. This section concerns the internal knowledge platform, not the Atlas product.

sources.title: Atlas Data Retention
sources.heading: Backups
sources.text: Backup copies are overwritten after 30 calendar days. A deleted ticket may therefore remain temporarily in backups. This document does not promise restoration of individual tickets.

sources.title: Backup Operations Handbook
sources.heading: Conflict
sources.text: The retention statement concerns the same system as document NL-24. No precedence rule exists between these two active documents. A definitive answer must be confirmed with the system owner.

sources.title: Knowledge Platform Backup Plan
sources.heading: Clarification
sources.text: This plan and the Backup Operations Handbook are both marked active. The plan specifies no precedence rule over the handbook. Refer conflicting statements to the system owner.
